poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Hold one dumbbell in front of your thigh with your palm toward you.

poses.label: Raise
poses.description: Lift the dumbbell forward with a slight bend in the elbow.

poses.label: Shoulder
poses.description: Stop at shoulder height without leaning back.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower slowly, then repeat on the other side.

limitations: The working arm is shown from the side. The current camera partly obscures palm orientation.
Phone playback and admin review are pending.
